Kill a dangerous charr named [[Garfazz Bloodfang]] and end his villainy.

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = prophecies
}}

===Objectives===
* Go to the [[Diessa Lowlands]]. Kill [[Garfazz Bloodfang]].
* Return to Viggo for your reward.

===Reward===
* 500 [[Experience]]
* 100 [[Gold]] ({{reforgedmode}} only)
* [[Cane]] (uses skin of [[Deadly Cesta]])
** [[Chaos Dmg]]: 4-7 (Requires 3 [[Illusion Magic]])
** [[Energy]] +3 (while Enchanted)
** [[Health]] +10 (while Enchanted)
* [[Long Sword]]
** [[Slashing Dmg]]: 10-14 (Requires 3 [[Swordsmanship]])
** Damage +15% (while Hexed)
** Damage +15% (while Enchanted)

==Walkthrough==
Travel to Diessa Lowlands; [[Grendich Courthouse]] is conveniently close to the location of the quest. If you don't want to kill all the Charr surrounding Garfazz, attack him from the north. You will be able to [[pull]] him away from most of the others easily, and with more careful pulling he can be engaged by himself.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Viggo
:''"My last time out, I nearly slew this bloated coward of a Charr, '''Garfazz Bloodfang'''. Bloodfang and his forces fled northwest, into the '''Diessa Lowlands'''. The duke won't let me lead a group after him. Says it's not strategic."''

:''"Well, I've never known the duke to be wrong about a thing like that, but if you were to hunt down that fur-wrapped vermin, I'd do my best to see to it you were duly rewarded."''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = Consider him dead already.
| decline = Personal vendettas have no place in warfare.
| ask = Yeah, I'd like to see '''Garfazz''' get what's coming to him. Killed two of our men and then ran like the blazes. He was trying to lure us into a trap, so the duke wouldn't let us pursue.
}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Viggo
:''"So you got Garfazz, eh?  I want to hear all the gory details... No, actually, forget it.  I'd rather keep the image that's in my mind now.  The real thing might not be as good, right?"''

==Notes==
